name: code-quality-marketplace
description: A marketplace for the Code Quality Workflow plugin, providing a multi-agent workflow for code review, issue consolidation, focused code fixes, reusable code-quality guidance, and post-edit validation reminders.

plugins.name: code-quality-workflow
plugins.description: A multi-agent code quality plugin that runs parallel correctness and maintainability reviews, consolidates and deduplicates findings, applies focused fixes through a scoped fixer agent, provides reusable code-quality guidance, and triggers post-edit validation reminders.
